pokedexEntries.su: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

pokedexEntries.mo: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It’s possible that it may survive if it’s put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

pokedexEntries.us: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

pokedexEntries.um: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.
